caption_L1: This bar plot is titled U.S. Millennials : Share of consumers ' food expenditure in 2012 , by store type. There is a categorical scale with Club stores on one end and Traditional grocery store at the other along the x-axis, labeled Response. There is a linear scale of range 0.0 to 0.4 along the y-axis, labeled Share of expenditure.
caption_L2L3: The majority of millennials' expenditure is spent in traditional grocery stores. The smallest amount of expenditure is spent on online, internet-based retailers. The amount spent in traditional grocery stores is ahead by quite some distance.
